empty.title: No rooms have been scanned yet
empty.description: Open the Inventory iPhone app, choose Rooms, and scan a room with RoomPlan. Its 3D model and every spatially captured inventory item will appear here.

rooms.title: Rooms in 3D
rooms.subtitle: Navigate RoomPlan scans and open inventory items at their measured positions.

scene.noItemsDescription: Capture an item in this room with the AR mode in the iPhone app.

ai.title: AI room analysis
ai.finishReviewHint: Confirm each finish before it changes the 3D room.
ai.unplaced: Visible in photos · no reliable 3D anchor
ai.estimatedAvailable: Visible in photos · estimated placement available
ai.estimateGizmoHint: Drag the arrows to move the estimate. Use Rotate to adjust its direction. Your camera stays unchanged.
ai.reviewHint: Grounded suggestions replace their RoomPlan object. Ungrounded suggestions use a clearly marked estimate that you can move. Nothing changes without confirmation.

layout.title: Arrange this floor
layout.description: Select a room in the 3D view, then move or rotate it directly with the gizmo.
layout.mapBackgroundHint: Show rooms on the map. Uses Mapbox when configured, otherwise the available basemap.
layout.mapSetupHint: Place and orient the room on the map. Saving activates the map background.
layout.mapHint: Drag a room to move it. Drag the orange handle to rotate it.
layout.mapUnavailable: A geographic anchor is required for the map background.
layout.mapCanvas: Map background beneath the 3D room view
layout.moveTool: Move the room freely across the floor
layout.rotateTool: Rotate the room around the vertical axis
layout.gizmoHint: Select a room · drag the gizmo to move on X/Z or rotate around Y
layout.step: Drag the gizmo freely · fine-tune: 25 cm / 5°
layout.mapStep: Move the 3D room over the map or use the precise 25 cm / 5° controls.

canvas.unsupported: 3D rendering is not supported by this browser.

lighting.label: Lighting quality
lighting.liveDescription: Fast daylight preview with consistent material colors and contact shadows.
lighting.progressiveDescription: Precompute room lighting with fewer rays, using the same materials and light colors as the realistic view.
lighting.progressiveQualityDescription: Higher settings accumulate more lighting samples for smoother shadows.
lighting.realisticDescription: Compute light and shadows for each room with indirect bounces while preserving material colors and finishes.
lighting.renderingDescription: Path-trace the current camera for about 20 seconds with multi-bounce light; slower devices may take longer.
lighting.baking: Baking ray-traced global illumination and shadows… {{progress}}%
lighting.baked: Baked global illumination and shadows ready
lighting.roomOnlyDescription: Exclude furniture from lightmap textures while preserving its baked shadows on the room.
lighting.slowDescription: Use a larger lightmap, more ray samples, and deeper light bounces. This can take up to five minutes.
lighting.cacheHint: Completed renders are saved on this device.

asset.tooLarge: Asset is too large for the browser — showing RoomPlan
asset.partial: Photorealistic view is memory-limited — remaining rooms use RoomPlan

canvas.mapBackgroundHint: North-up map view · the 3D model is aligned above its location
canvas.controlsHint: Drag: rotate · two fingers: pan · scroll: zoom

walk.hint: WASD / arrows to move · Shift to hurry · C to crouch · Space to jump · Esc to release mouse. On touch devices, drag to look and use direction buttons.

models.fallback: Model library could not be loaded. Showing simplified models.

editor.title: Edit room
editor.furnitureHint: Select furniture in the 3D view or below. Preview the model and color before saving.
editor.mapHint: Click the room center on the map or drag the marker. Then adjust the heading (0° = north). The preview shows the actual room outline.
editor.heading: Heading from north (°)
editor.splitHint: A partition splits the scan into two rooms. The new room uses the entered name. The line must not intersect furniture.
editor.scanHint: In the iOS app, use “Scan again” to recapture an existing room. Here you can import updated room JSON in the same coordinate system and preview it before saving. AI suggestions will be reset.

errors.edit-failed: Could not save the change. Please try again.
errors.invalid-edit: Invalid room data. Check the file and values.
errors.revision-conflict: This scan has changed. Reload before editing again.
errors.coordinate-frame-changed: The imported scan uses a different coordinate system. Rescan using the iOS app.
errors.split-too-small: Both rooms must be at least 80 cm wide.
errors.split-crosses-furniture: The partition intersects furniture. Move the line.
errors.split-missing-floor: Both rooms must retain a floor surface.
errors.invalid-transform: This geometry cannot be split here.
errors.object-not-found: This furniture is no longer in the scan.
errors.surface-not-found: These dimensions or this position are invalid.
errors.surface-category-changed: These dimensions or this position are invalid.
errors.surface-too-small: These dimensions or this position are invalid.

editor.regenerateHint: Rebuilds the view using the current model library. Room dimensions, map position, furniture edits and accepted AI suggestions are preserved.
editor.regenerated: View regenerated from the room data.

architecture.hint: Edit dimensions, position and material. Doors and windows move with their wall. X/Y/Z are scan coordinates; Y is height.
architecture.windowHint: Color and material apply to the window frame. Glazing remains transparent.
architecture.invalid: These dimensions or this position are invalid.
